The structure of SrBiH₅ crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a unit cell containing 28 atoms—Sr₄Bi₄H₂₀—distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral coordination for both Bi and Sr centers, each with six H neighbors; the Bi octahedra share edges with one another and corners with Sr octahedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 28 sites. These coordination and connectivity results are geometry-derived, not chemical-bond assignments.
